Giotto object history

Source: R/function_logging.R
objHistory.Rd

The steps recorded on a giotto object: one record per step, holding the function (fn), the parameters it ran with as deparsed expressions (params), and timestamp, seed, status, error and diff. Steps recorded before these records existed are reported with status = "ok" and the parameters they recorded.

The history can also be read back without loading the object: pass the folder written by saveGiotto(), or the path to its history.ndjson. The result is the same as objHistory() on the object at save time.

The history is provenance, not state: only functions that opt in are recorded. What the object holds comes from objManifest().

Usage

# S4 method for class 'gAny'
objHistory(
  x,
  summarized = FALSE,
  output = c("ghistory", "ndjson"),
  file = NULL,
  ...
)

# S4 method for class 'ghistory'
objHistory(
  x,
  summarized = FALSE,
  output = c("ghistory", "ndjson"),
  file = NULL,
  ...
)

# S4 method for class 'character'
objHistory(
  x,
  summarized = FALSE,
  output = c("ghistory", "ndjson"),
  file = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

giotto object, a history from objHistory(), or the path to a saveGiotto() folder or its history.ndjson. A disk-backed project directory is read through its source: pass name to pick a snapshot (the most recent by default).

summarized

logical. Whether to also print a summary of the steps and the names they used

output

character. "ghistory" (default) returns the records as a list; "ndjson" returns them as newline-delimited JSON, one step per line.

file

character. Optional path to write the history to as NDJSON. When given, the path is returned invisibly and output is ignored.

...

additional params (none implemented)

Value

list of class ghistory, an NDJSON string, or the file path invisibly

Examples

g <- GiottoData::loadGiottoMini("visium")

objHistory(g)
objHistory(g, summarized = TRUE)
cat(substr(objHistory(g, output = "ndjson"), 1, 120))
